title: Pool Nexus: compact telemetry + controls for Dedicated GPU pools
creator: Ava Martinez
description: Design a compact, single-line telemetry and control surface for Dedicated GPU pools that fits the Console's resource-listing rows and a detailed inspector. The component ("Pool Nexus") should surface real-time health micro-visuals, quick autoscale controls, burst window presets, and an immediate cost-delta preview without forcing users into a full modal. Emphasis on density (for fleet overviews), quick remediation flows, and clear affordances for canary rollouts or emergency throttles.
acceptance_criteria: Row-level compact control renders in fleet list with CPU/GPU memory usage microbars and 5s streaming sparkline
Autoscale quick-toggle and 3 preset policies (conservative, balanced, aggressive) editable inline
Burst editor opens an in-context flyout with start/end, cap and preflight cost estimate; changes validate and preview cost delta before apply
Rollout slider allows canary percentage selection and immediate preview of route fallback and latency impact
Cost overlay shows per-token and per-minute delta for the proposed setting change and links to cost breakdown dashboard
Component accessible (keyboard focus, aria labels) and responsive down to 1024px wide console panes
Design spec includes states for healthy/degraded/offline and recommended remediation actions (drain, scale-up, fallback-to-variant)
Prototype linked and usability-tested with 4 platform engineers/2 PMs with at least 3 actionable feedback items resolved
updates: 2026-02-25: Ticket created by Ava Martinez after product jam; scope agreed with PM: single-line control + inspector flyout
2026-02-28: Exploratory sketches completed; three layout directions (mini-card, inline-accordion, dense-chip) — decision: dense-chip for fleet list, flyout inspector for edits
2026-03-03: Figma mid-fidelity prototype shared with Eng; feedback: prefer explicit confirmation for burst changes, require cost preview before commit
2026-03-05: Updated prototype: added preflight cost estimator and a two-step apply (preview -> confirm); added network conditions indicator to telemetry

2026-03-07: Design review with PM, infra SRE and Runtime Eng. SRE asked for an emergency throttle (panic) button; Runtime asked for a toggle to route to a cheaper quantized variant when overloaded — added to backlog

2026-03-10: Usability micro-session (4 engineers, 2 PMs). Observations: users expect auto-suggestion for burst presets and wanted tooltips for predicted latency impact. Adjusted copy and added micro-animations to surface change impact. Moving to In Progress for hi-fi + handoff
notes_for_engineering: Provide a streaming telemetry endpoint (5s granularity) and a cost-preview API that returns per-token and per-minute deltas for a proposed autoscale/burst config. The flyout should accept a JSON patch for cluster settings and return validation errors inline.
handoff_checklist: Acceptance criteria mapped to dev stories
